title: Injection family
status: AUTHORED. The classic surface, with the context-first rule most scanners violate.

atom_notes.A01: the primitive: data the first layer treated as inert is executed downstream
atom_notes.A05: the same bytes parse differently in two layers, which is how filters get bypassed
atom_notes.A11: deserialization needs a gadget, so the dependency set is part of the attack
atom_notes.A04: second order injection means the sink is a different request than the source

required_cells.why: identify sink and context before choosing a payload, or you are spraying
detection at scale needs a differential oracle, not a payload list
arithmetic or timing control proves the sink is real
serialization classes need the dependency set, not just the parameter
retest after a filter change, the class most likely to regress
continuous injection regression as code changes

entries.name: sqlmap
entries.role: SQL injection detection and exploitation, the reference implementation
preconditions: a parameter that reaches a query
error, boolean or time based signal available
oracle: extracted data that could not come from the application
time delay proportional to the payload
detected_by: query error signatures, unusual query time
entries.note: Never dump against production. Level 2 risk 1 is usually enough; higher is loud.

entries.name: commix
entries.role: OS command injection, the counterpart for the shell sink
preconditions: a parameter that reaches a shell
oracle: timing or output consistent with execution
detected_by: process spawn from a request handler
entries.note: Blind time based first, then a reversible side effect. No destructive commands.

tree.q: Do you know which interpreter receives the value?
tree.why: Every injection class is defined by its sink, and the payload is a consequence of the sink. Choosing a payload before a sink is how scanners produce false positives.

branches.action: find the sink first. arithmetic or syntax that only one interpreter evaluates beats a payload list
branches.oracle: a response only that interpreter could produce

branches.action: read the handlers, pick a context payload, confirm with a callback under a control
boolean and time based pairs, never a destructive statement
branches.oracle: differential or timing with a matched control

branches.action: blind time based first, then a reversible side effect
branches.oracle: timing control plus a benign artefact

branches.action: identify the sink and the classpath, then match a gadget
store then trigger a different read. the oracle is in the second request
branches.oracle: effect appears on a later read

gaps.gap: No tool identifies the sink from behaviour without a class specific probe
gaps.build_candidate: a polyglot probe set where each member is evaluated by exactly one interpreter, ordered by safety

gaps.gap: No second order scanner that tracks a value from store to later sink
gaps.build_candidate: tag a benign canary, store it, then watch every later response for the tag in a sink context

gaps.gap: No safe SSTI prober that never sends an execution payload
gaps.build_candidate: arithmetic only, with a control that must not evaluate
